jobWithRoomOnlyOutsideItsPlaceMoves.pins: (its place is abc without n1; the room at abc is on n1)

jobsThatDoNotWaitForResourcesStay.pins: held, waiting for a start time or dependency, not seen by the scheduler yet, running, or with room where they are (abc has room for 2: the one not seen yet and the last one)

limitThatPendingJobsWaitForClosesAPlace.pins: limit that pending jobs wait for closes aplace

mainPlaceIsNotLeftOutWhenSlurmRefusesItO.pins: (no room there then, but it is the user's place: asked again)

mainPlaceOfGPUNodesTakesCPUJobs.pins: (the main place is the user's choice: used as before)

memoryPerCPUOfAPlaceWithoutOneComesFromI.pins: (the smallest RealMemory / CPUs of its nodes: 1031600 / 128 MB)

noSlurmCallsBeforeAJobHasWaited.pins: no slurm calls before ajob has waited

onlyAsManyJobsMoveAsFit.pins: gpu8 has room for 2 jobs of 4 CPUs of 21418 MB

optionsOfASlurmParamAreRead.pins: options of aslurm param are read

pendingJobMovesToAPlaceWithRoom.pins: (at gpu8 it keeps its abc shape)

pendingJobsAreFoundByTheirIds.pins: (the first pending job in squeue's list is held; the second one waits for resources and moves)

pendingJobsOfTheUserStartFirst.pins: abc has 8 free CPUs, which a pending job of the user takes

placeSlurmRefusesIsNotUsed.pins: place slurm refuses is not used

placesTakeTheMainSettingsForKeysTheyLeav.pins: places take the main settings for keys they leave out

placesWithOtherOptionsDoNotTrade.pins: options a pending job can't change (here --exclusive), and a place without a QOS for jobs of another partition (Slurm keeps the job's QOS, also one the new partition doesn't allow)

plannedNodesHaveNoRoom.pins: a node the backfill scheduler planned for a pending job keeps its free CPUs for it

singleJobGoesToThePlaceWithRoomAndMoves.pins: the pipeline's and decon's single jobs (main place gpu8 without GPU headroom): submitted to abc (gpu8 full) with an abc shape, then moved back to gpu8 once it has room and abc not (keeping the abc shape), by the wrapper's and check_single_job_status's looks at pending jobs

slurmsOwnCheckDecides.pins: the nodes have room, Slurm says the job would start later

TaskMetricsTest.pins: task metrics of the job framework (task_metrics, read_task_metrics): with taskMetrics, every task run leaves a record of its resources in <jobLogDir>/task_metrics/<run>/ (local loop, MATLAB jobs, compiled tasks, local pool, single jobs), and without it nothing changes. Slurm is faked (pktest.FakeSlurmFixture): the MATLAB command of a job is run in this MATLAB, a compiled task line with bash and...

bashTaskExitStatusIsRecorded.pins: bash task exit status is recorded

callWithoutMetricsClearsTaskEnvironment.pins: a compiled task with metrics runs a framework call without metrics: the tasks of that call (which get this environment, e.g., through sbatch) must not record into the task's run

compiledJobsKeepAJoblog.pins: GNU parallel records each task line's start, run time and exit status in the run's metrics folder

compiledLocalRunKeepsAJoblog.pins: without a cluster the master runs the task lines with GNU parallel (here a stand-in that logs its arguments) and keeps a joblog in the metrics folder

compiledTaskLinesAreUnchangedWithoutMetr.pins: compiled task lines are unchanged without metrics

compiledTaskLinesCarryMetricsEnvironment.pins: compiled task lines carry metrics environment

failedLocalTaskIsRecordedAndStillFails.pins: failed local task is recorded and still fails

gpuTaskLinesAskForTheGPU.pins: a GPU task records its GPU (the flag is only in GPU task lines)

masterComputedTasksAreRecordedAsMaster.pins: in cluster mode with masterCompute the master runs the last batch itself (here task 2; the job of task 1 writes its output)

matlabJobCommandIsUnchangedWithoutMetric.pins: matlab job command is unchanged without metrics

matlabJobStatementRethrowsTaskErrors.pins: a failed task fails its job as before, after its record

matlabJobStatementRunsWithoutTaskMetrics.pins: a job whose MATLAB can't find task_metrics still runs its task

matlabJobsRunEachTaskWithMetrics.pins: (the MATLAB command of jobs without task runners; TaskRunnerTest has the runners' records)

mccMasterRecordsTaskFromEnvironment.pins: a compiled task gets its metrics settings from its task line's environment

memoryAndCpuOnLinux.pins: the peak resident memory is the task's own: it is reset at the start of each task (a task that allocates 512 MB, then one that doesn't); user and system CPU add up to the CPU time (a task that computes, mostly user time: in small arrays, as faulting in large ones is system time, which on a busy machine was half)

nestedRunRecordsItsParent.pins: a task that runs framework calls of its own (large-file tasks do, one after another): the inner calls record the outer task as their parent

poolTasksAreRecordedOnTheWorkers.pins: pool tasks are recorded on the workers

readerJoinsJoblogAndRunSettings.pins: a compiled run: GNU parallel's joblog gives the time from the end of a task to the end of its process, and lines without a record (the process was killed, or the output existed)

readerLabelsTasksTheMasterRan.pins: compiled tasks in the master's own Slurm job ran in the master

singleCompiledJobCarriesMetricsEnvironme.pins: single compiled job carries metrics environment

singleJobWithoutMetricsClearsTaskEnviron.pins: single job without metrics clears task environment

singleJobsRecordSubmissionAndTask.pins: single jobs record submission and task

unwritableMetricsDoNotFailTasks.pins: a file where the metrics folder would be: no metrics, but the tasks run as usual

TaskRunnerTest.pins: task runners of the job framework (task_runner, task_runner_run, task_runner.sh): a process runs one task after another, its batch's first, then unstarted tasks of the call's other batches, with claims in the call folder. The job script runs with a stand-in compiled master (a bash script that runs a fake task and, as a runner, claims and runs the next tasks as task_runner does); the MATLAB runn...

batchesWaitThirtySecondsBeforeRunnersTak.pins: the master lists a batch for the runners once its tasks have waited 30 s in the queue (or for their submission)

callFolderInTheHomeFolderAsTildeRunsItsT.pins: a call folder given as ~/... (data paths such as the demos' ~/Downloads/...): the job script finds the claims and tasks (bash doesn't expand ~ in the script's quoted paths)

claimStatesFollowTheirOwners.pins: a claim is live while its owner's job is in the queue (running or pending), or (no job) while its process runs on this node; failed claims, the master's own and those of ended jobs are not

claimsAreTakenOnceUnderConcurrency.pins: many runners claiming at once: each task once

compiledEmptyJobLogDirIsTheDefaultFolder.pins: compiled mode: an empty jobLogDir (as from a config file) gave the jobs "-o -e", so their logs went to a file named -e in the folder the framework submits from (the code folder); it is now the default folder (../job_logs beside the code folder if it is there, else <data folder>/job_logs; the fake jobs make their log files only in the test's folders)

compiledJobsRunTheJobScript.pins: with a build that has task runners, a first submission runs the batch with the call's job script (one slot per GNU parallel slot, stealing, two tries as --retries 2), with the job's resources as before; a sequential job has one slot and one try; a GPU job gives each slot its GPU

compiledLocalCallDoneInItsLastTryRemoves.pins: compiled mode, a local run (as a compiled stitching job runs its cross-correlations): the batch run in its last try ran after its round looked at the outputs, so the call returned it unfinished, kept its task folder in tmp/ (the task lines and the runners' files) and its caller ran it again; the call now looks once more at its end. With task runners (their pass runs every task once) and without

compiledMasterKeepsItsBatch.pins: compiled mode: the batch the master runs itself (the last one) has its own key, so other jobs' runners leave its tasks to it; the other batches have the CPUs of their jobs (the compiled wrapper directly: the framework lets only a compiled master compute in compiled mode)

compiledMasterLeavesTasksToRunningRunner.pins: compiled mode: a task another job's runner took is not submitted while that job runs; then its batch is submitted

compiledResubmissionsRunAsBefore.pins: compiled mode: a batch resubmitted after its job ended without its output runs the job command of before

compiledRunnerTasksGetTheEnvironmentOfTh.pins: the metrics environment a task line sets (PETAKIT5D_TASK...) is set for the task in the runner too

compiledTaskLinesCheckTildeOutputs.pins: compiled mode with outputs given as ~/...: the task lines check the outputs in bash, which doesn't expand ~ in their quoted paths, so they have the home folder in its place (with the job script's task lines and with GNU parallel's)

failedTaskRunsAgainInItsOwnProcessAndIsM.pins: a task error and a crash: each task runs once more in a process of its own (as GNU parallel --retries 2 did), then it is marked failed; the other tasks run, and the slot takes no more tasks of other batches

gpuSlotsGetOneDeviceEach.pins: gpu slots get one device each

jobLeavesClaimedTasksResubmittedBatchesA.pins: a task another job claimed, a task whose output exists, and a batch the master resubmitted (its job runs it)

jobRunsEachTaskOnceInFewerProcesses.pins: job runs each task once in fewer processes

jobStartsNoMoreSlotsThanTasks.pins: as GNU parallel started one process per task line, a job starts no more slots than it has tasks to take (each slot starts 0.2 s after the one before, and the job ends after the last one)

jobTakesOnlyTasksOfBatchesWithItsKey.pins: a batch's key: the CPUs and GPU of its job's processes, or 'master' for the batch the master runs itself; a runner takes other batches' tasks only if they have the key of its own

jobTakesUnstartedTasksOfOtherBatches.pins: job takes unstarted tasks of other batches

jobWithNoTaskLeftStartsNoProcess.pins: job with no task left starts no process

localRunsFindTheTmpFilesOfTildePaths.pins: a local run whose .tmp files and outputs are given as ~/... (the demos' data paths): the job script finds the .tmp files (bash doesn't expand ~ in the paths it reads from tmps.txt), so a task that another call processes is left to it, as with full paths

localRunsRunATaskARunnerGaveBack.pins: local runs: a task a runner gives back (e.g. its memory guard) loses the .tmp of its claim and runs in a new process at once

localRunsSkipTasksThatOtherCallsProcess.pins: local runs (no cluster) keep the .tmp files with which framework calls on the same data share their tasks: a task whose .tmp is younger than the wait time is left alone, an older one is taken; .tmp files of finished tasks are removed

masterLeavesTasksToRunningRunnersAndResu.pins: a task another job's runner took is not submitted while that job runs; when the job is gone without its output, the claim is removed and the task's batch submitted

matlabJobMarksTasksItDidNotFinish.pins: a task a MATLAB job's process didn't finish is marked failed (the master resubmits its batch with more CPUs), and the job then takes no tasks of other batches

matlabJobSeesTildeOutputsThatExist.pins: MATLAB mode with outputs given as ~/...: the job script's output checks find outputs that exist (bash doesn't expand ~ in their quoted paths), so it starts no MATLAB for them

matlabJobWithNoTaskLeftStartsNoMatlab.pins: a MATLAB job starts MATLAB only for a task it claimed

matlabJobsRunTheJobScript.pins: MATLAB jobs: the job script starts MATLAB (with the launch string of before) if tasks are left; off: the command of before

matlabResubmissionsRunAsBefore.pins: a batch resubmitted after its job ended without its output runs the MATLAB command of before (no runner, no stealing)

matlabRunnerRecordsTaskMetrics.pins: with task metrics, each task a MATLAB runner runs has its record; the job script starts MATLAB with the launch string

matlabRunnerRunsCompoundTaskStrings.pins: a task string of several statements (callers with functions of their own pass e.g. "addpath(dir); f(...)") runs whole in a MATLAB job's runner, also the tasks of other batches it takes: str2func takes only a single call, so it runs with eval

matlabRunnerRunsItsBatchThenOtherBatches.pins: a MATLAB job's runner: its batch, then the other batches' tasks from the last one; the base workspace keeps its variables

oneTaskPerSlotRunsTaskLinesAsBefore.pins: with one task per slot and no batch waiting in the queue, the task lines run as before (no runner; a slot that is done takes another batch's task the same way); with a batch that waits, the processes are runners and take its tasks

processWithManyMoreOpenFilesIsRecycled.pins: before a runner's next task, the job script compares its open files with those after its first task: 64 more end the process

runnerEndsAfterATaskThatChangesTheThread.pins: all tasks of a process run with its thread count (MATLAB fixes at the first FFT how a process's FFTs use threads): a task that changes it ends the process, and a new one runs the next task

runnerEndsAfterItsTime.pins: a process runs tasks for PETAKIT5D_RUNNER_MINUTES (10) at most

runnerGivesMccMasterTheArgumentsOfTheTas.pins: the runner must give mccMaster what run_mccMaster.sh gives the compiled mccMaster for the same task line: paths with spaces, cell arrays, empty strings, numbers, non-ASCII characters, final outputs

runnerRecyclesAProcessThatHoldsMemory.pins: after a task the process holds more memory than at its start (beyond the margin): it ends, and a new process runs the next

runnerRecyclesAProcessWhoseLaterTaskHold.pins: a later task: compared with the process after its first task and the reset (with the libraries the tasks load)

runnerResetsTheProcessBetweenTasks.pins: each task sees the state the process had before its first one

runnersAreOnlyUsedWithBuildsThatHaveThem.pins: a build without task_runner.txt (made before runners) or with another runner version runs as before; runners need Linux

stealingStopsNearTheJobsEnd.pins: a job takes tasks of other batches only if it has the time for them (twice the longest task so far and a minute); its own tasks run anyway

taskRunnerOffOrOldBuildsRunAsBefore.pins: taskRunner false (option or config key), or a build without task runners: the job commands of before and no runner files

tasksWithoutInputsStayInTheirBatch.pins: a task whose input was missing when the call started runs only in its own batch's job (as before), not in another job's runner

WaitForFilesTest.pins: wait_for_files, the wait of the callers of single jobs between their rounds: at most waitTime, until all files of one group exist. pause is a spy (it doesn't wait); files appear at its calls (pktest.atCall).

filesThatDoNotComeTakeTheWholeWait.pins: a look after each second, none at the end (the caller's round looks then)

patternsCountOnlyFinishedNames.pins: a pattern, as the pipeline looks for a stitched result: the result's temporary name (with a suffix) doesn't count, its final name does

slowLooksAreFewer.pins: a look that takes 0.3 s (slow storage, many files): the next ones are 3 s or more apart, so that looking takes at most a tenth of the wait, which stays the same

waitEndsOnceAllFilesOfOneGroupExist.pins: one group (the callers' results): a during the second second, b during the third

waitEndsOnceTheFilesOfAGroupExist.pins: groups {a, b} and {c}: b comes during the second second, a during the third

withoutFilesItIsOnePause.pins: without files it is one pause
